title: Krrsantan
description: Black Krrsantan was a Wookie bounty hunter and former gladiator. The Hutt Twins sent him to attack Boba Fett at his palace. Fett's allies managed to capture Krrsantan. Fett opted to give Krransantan this freedom and later recruited the Wookiee to work for him. After the Battle of Mos Espa was over, Krrsantan remained in Fett's service.
